reasons: Primary HOLDOUT-DTI failed: 0.05791 [0.04849, 0.06719] < Champion 0.09920 and repository best H38 0.11696; paired delta vs Champion -0.04129 [-0.05498, -0.02770].
Independent off-catalogue SGMC improved to 0.08780 [0.07392, 0.09958] vs Champion 0.06412, but proxy improvement cannot override the failed primary holdout.
Surface uniqueness passed across 304 refreshed registry files (max |Spearman| 0.12942), but final-dot lane uniqueness failed at 99.43% > 70% against the registered spacing-5 calibration lattice.
The dot mask is not pixel-identical to any refreshed registry raster and the GeoTIFF is cryptographically new, but that is weaker than the mandatory lane-overlap rule.
The full-grid format validator passes; format validity alone is not scientific or slot authorization.
submission_authorization.next_required: Do not upload Arena9. A future lane must beat H38 on the same fold-local hide-and-recover evaluator and satisfy the literal all-registry overlap rule. The spacing-5 registry lattice makes a 37,654-dot map infeasible under that rule; do not invent an exemption—resolve the protocol or use a preregistered lower budget before any further experiment.
